description: **Route completions through the lifecycle guard.** Audit finding: the guard had never guarded a real feature — 321 managed features, 31 registered guard resources, ZERO overlap (all 31 are leaked test fixtures), 230 COMPLETE features none of which passed a guarded transition. `COMP-MCP-ENFORCE/report.md:8,52` claims "no caller can effect an unverified transition"; that has always been false (AC-14, still outstanding). Cause: the writers that actually complete features never call a guarded transition at all — registration was always possible (`guardedTransition` registers lazily), it simply never happened. Design rev 6 after five Codex rounds (8→8→7→7→7 findings, flat — the pre-registered stopping criterion fired, so the work was sliced instead of reviewed harder). Slice 1 SHIPPED @753ed47: `lib/completion-gate.js` gates `record_completion` (MCP + CLI) — evidence verification, write-ahead intent, guarded transition; `roadmap add --status COMPLETE` refused; `--tests-pass` default removed (BREAKING). Slice 2 SHIPPED @4625b2b: the build runner. Exactly one completion, at terminalization, AFTER the health gate — previously the terminal block wrote COMPLETE before the health gate that can fail the build, and ship had already written a second record. Tests hoisted above the non-git branch (which returned before running them and hard-coded tests_pass:true); `deriveTestsAttested` tri-state; accumulator v1→v2 with `tests_attested`/`evidence_root`. Slice 3 SHIPPED 2026-08-30: the gate owns the §2.3a write sequence (record → status via `persistFeatureRaw` → ROADMAP → vision → events; projection failures reported `partial:true`); `setFeatureStatus` refuses COMPLETE unconditionally; `recordCompletion` delegates its completing path to the gate (`COMPLETION_REFUSED`, nothing written); `server/completion-projection.js` is the self-verifying predicate (§2.3b) with four transports (REST endpoint, in-process `applyVerifiedProjection` for cockpit + reconciler, `VisionWriter.completeItem` direct, startup seeding) and three tiers stamped as `completion_projection.verified_by` (guarded / canonical-status-only / document-derived; only `not_found` means legacy, everything else fails closed); refusals on paths 5/7/8/14 keyed on MANAGED build items (bound + build + feature.json exists — the `compose new` kickoff item and fix/plan items keep their paths); cockpit `/lifecycle/complete` goes through the gate; `roadmap migrate` exemption named + logged on both branches (AC-17); AC-19 two-sided allowlist scan test; AC-14 report correction. Correct sentence now: build-mode completions of managed features are evidence-checked, ledgered and single-doored — NOT lifecycle-enforced. Deferred: paths 9 (GitHub half)/15 → COMP-COMPLETION-GATE-REMOTE; fix/plan modes → COMP-COMPLETION-GATE-MODES.
